subject: Intro call prep: production fit, throughput, and demo slots
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fitmart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro call prep: production fit, throughput, and demo slots

Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood! I reviewed the brief you submitted via the self-serve form — looks like a promising fit. Before we lock a demo, two quick things to make sure we tailor the session: 

1) Primary use case: are you planning to use generation (conversational agents, summaries) or embeddings/semantic search for product search? If both, rough split?
2) Expected steady-state traffic: average QPS or daily requests (tokens per month is fine) and peak concurrency we should design for.
3) Timeline & success criteria: pilot date you’d like (POC next month vs later), and what counts as a successful pilot (latency below X, error rate, cost target, etc.).
4) Any compliance/SSO/KMS requirements we should know about ahead of a private demo or enterprise discussion?

If you can reply with short bullets I’ll propose three demo slots tailored to your stack (we’ll demo embeddings vs generation cost/latency tradeoffs and a short walkthrough of integration). If you prefer, here’s my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/jordan/30min

Best,
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
[jordan@redwood.ai]

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference

From: Samir Patel <samir@fitmart.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 12:40:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call prep: production fit, throughput, and demo slots

Jordan — thanks for the quick follow. Answers below. Short bullets as requested: 

1) Use case: mainly embeddings for product search + a small set of generation flows (cart summarize + product Q&A). We expect embeddings to be primary (≈80%).
2) Traffic: current catalog search hits are ~250k queries/day; expected POC traffic ~10k/day, eventual steady-state goal ~300k/day with bursts. Concurrency: peaks ~150 concurrent requests during batch runs.
3) Timeline: hoping to run a 4-week pilot in August; success = under 150ms median generation for short replies, embedding search under 50ms median, and total infra cost below $0.05/query (target).
4) Compliance: we have SSO + SCIM; procurement will require a basic security questionnaire and SSO details. No HSM at pilot stage but will discuss later.

One additional thing — can the demo show how to instrument and track per-route token costs in the console? That will be a big part of our evaluation.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Search & Recommendations, FitMart
samir@fitmart.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@fitmart.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call prep: production fit, throughput, and demo slots

Great — that helps a lot, thanks. We’ll focus the demo on embedding indexing patterns and how to route requests between a lower-cost embedding model and a higher-fidelity generation model for the Q&A flows. We’ll also show per-route token cost breakdowns in the Console and a short runbook for monitoring regressions during the pilot.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Jul 6 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 7 — 13:00–13:30
- Fri Jul 9 — 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/jordan/30min

Prep note: if you can share a sample query profile or a small CSV with traffic shape (hour-of-day, avg qps) beforehand that helps us set realistic batching and cache defaults for the demo.

Attaching a short checklist we typically use for pilots (SSO, sample traffic, pilot success metrics).

Cheers,
Jordan
--
[Attachment: RDWD-pilot-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@fitmart.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
